description: This Java class 'IniFileMetaInfo' provides metadata information for an INI file, including page sizes, signatures, and read commands. It processes a RawIniFile object to extract properties like number of pages, total size, signature, and associated page read commands.

classes.name: IniFileMetaInfo
classes.description: A class encapsulating metadata information about an INI file, including page sizes, signature, and read commands.

methods.name: IniFileMetaInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing metadata object from a RawIniFile instance, parsing page count, size, signature, and read commands.

methods.name: getnPages
methods.description: Returns the number of pages in the INI file.

methods.name: getBlockingFactor
methods.description: Returns the blocking factor used for reading chunks.

methods.name: getTotalSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the data read from the INI file.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature string associated with the INI file.

methods.name: getPageReadCommand
methods.description: Returns the read command string for a specific page by index.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a specific page by index.
